name: zoom-notetaker
title: Zoom notetaker
summary: Joins a Zoom meeting from its link, waits out the call, and writes up the notes.
blurb: Paste a Zoom link and get minutes back: one tool dispatches a Recall.ai notetaker bot into the call, a second waits for the meeting to end and brings home the transcript, and the same fixed-heading prompt as meeting-notes turns it into a summary, decisions, action items and open questions. The model never joins the meeting — two deterministic tool steps do, and the flow branches to a plain-spoken failure end when the bot could not get in or captions were off, rather than summarizing a meeting it never heard.
